_comment: Manifest entries outside nightly_matrix.json, run by .github/workflows/regression-extended.yml: weekly always, daily only when the account's Actions queue is idle. Must be manifest names, disjoint from the nightly list.

_excluded.mimo-asr: needs the --codec-model mimo-tokenizer companion, which run_one.py does not pass (exit 13)
_excluded.mimo-audio-tokenizer: outputs RVQ codes, not a transcript; run_one.py has no codes-hash check
_excluded.lid-cld3-f16: text LID fed via LID_TEXT; run_one.py does not set it (exit 3)
_excluded.titanet-large: outputs a speaker embedding; run_one.py has no embedding check (exit 3)
_excluded.ecapa-lid-107: LID: run_one.py runs plain transcription, CLI exits 3 (needs LID mode)
_excluded.fasttext-lid176: LID: run_one.py runs plain transcription, CLI exits 3 (needs LID mode)
_excluded.silero-lid-lang95: LID: run_one.py runs plain transcription, CLI exits 3 (needs LID mode)
_excluded.firered-lid: output 'En?' vs pinned 'en': driver needs a label-normalising LID check
_excluded.kugelaudio-0-open: TTS-only; manifest pins a stub sentence instead of a TTS roundtrip entry
_excluded.chatterbox-turbo-s3gen: -m points at the s3gen file; T3 model is not fetched or passed (rc 13)
_excluded.cosyvoice3-0.5b: default voice is a clone; driver must pass a non-clone voice or --i-have-rights (rc 17)
_excluded.dia-1.6b: DAC codec companion not fetched or passed (rc 15)
_excluded.zonos-v0.1-transformer: dac-44khz-f16.gguf companion not fetched or passed (rc 15)
_excluded.outetts-0.3-1b: wavtokenizer-decoder-f16.gguf companion not fetched or passed (rc 15)
_excluded.orpheus-3b-0.1-ft: driver passes speaker 'default'; orpheus needs tara/leah/... (rc 15)
_excluded.f5-tts-v1-base: synthesis exceeds the 300 s TTS timeout on a 4-vCPU runner
_excluded.indextts-1.5: synthesis ran but roundtrip transcript is empty (WER 1.0) - needs investigation
_excluded.tada-tts-3b-ml: synthesis ran but roundtrip transcript is empty (WER 1.0) - check codec companion
_excluded.parler-tts-mini-v1.1: intelligible but prepends babble, WER 1.11 vs max 0.2 - needs investigation
